G1_unambiguity.justification: The vector definitions and exact stress condition uniquely imply that the endpoints of every link must use different channels.

G2_completeness.justification: The statement specifies the assignment domain, input bounds and format, validity condition, output format, lexicographic tie-break, and edge cases such as zero links.

G3_faithfulness.justification: Because a same-channel link has stress 16 while every different-channel link has stress 4, achieving total stress 4m is exactly equivalent to the original requirement that no linked pair share a shift.

G4_naturalness.justification: The statement is clear and idiomatic, though the geometric stress construction is an unnecessarily elaborate presentation of a simple graph-coloring condition.
